title: test(dogfood): pin access-security checklist clauses at the oracle's layer, slice 3
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8YSjPf3hTSLEBa52VUBikb4)_

Refs #26571 (slice 3 of 4, items: access-security.anonymous-floor-v18-doors, access-security.meta-authoring-trail-and-audience-gates, access-security.security-catalog-activation-and-clone-doors, access-security.security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report, access-security.grant-table-write-contract)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：给 access-security 区第三批 5 个清单条目补上 dogfood 断言（进程内 HTTP 与启动日志，即这些条款 oracle 指定的层），共钉住 14 条此前只在单元层或靠手跑的条款；扩写 4 个现有用例文件，新增 4 个隔离用例文件。8 个条目的清单记录更新：本批 5 个的 `automated.ref` 逐条款改写，另外按席位要求把第二批 3 个条目（以及本批 one-holder 条目）的 `automated.kind` 从 `unit` 改成 `dogfood`；每个条目 `revision` 加一、`history` 记本卡。
- 为什么改：18.2.0 Tier 1 记录 #26468 把这 5 条判为 PARTIAL：错误码、管理员对照、备用读入口和启动日志都只在单元层或手跑。
- 风险与回滚：只加测试和改清单文字，不动产品代码，不加 CI 通道。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `meta-view-audience-alternate-doors.dogfood.test.ts`（受限视图在 /published、/layers、?state=draft、/history 各入口的拒绝，以及 ETag 回放不得 304）；② `security-catalog-one-holder-http.dogfood.test.ts`（install-local 重名拒绝与启动日志 50 条上限）；③ `access-security.json` 的 kind 改动。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/qa/dogfood && pnpm exec vitest run test/meta-view-audience-alternate-doors.dogfood.test.ts`（需先按 dogfood 惯例 build 依赖闭包），预期 `Tests 8 passed`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。余下 3 条（parent-and-organization-write-guards、deployment-tables-platform-only、share-link-combined-gates）在第 4 片。

## What changes

Each clause is pinned at the layer its oracle names. `api` is the in-process HTTP stack of `@objectstack/verify`, and `log` is the process output captured across a boot. All changes are in `packages/qa/dogfood/**`, with no product code changes. Every new assertion was written against today's behaviour and is green.

| item | clauses newly pinned | where |
|---|---|---|
| anonymous-floor-v18-doors | acceptance[1], [2] (admin leg), [3], [4] | New `anonymous-floor-v18-doors` (isolated). Each of steps[0]'s six doors answers an anonymous caller 401 with `UNAUTHENTICATED` or `AUTH_REQUIRED`. The admin's same GET is served 200 on every door except `/keys`, which serves POST alone and answers the admin's GET 405. A bogus share-link token gets a 4xx that is not 401. An anonymous form submit that forges `owner_id` and `status` answers 201 with exactly `{ id }`, and neither forged value is stored. `showcase-anonymous-deny-surfaces` gains the admin leg of the retired `/docs` comparison, which is read-only and stays in the shared project |
| meta-authoring-trail-and-audience-gates | acceptance[2], negative[0] | New `meta-view-audience-alternate-doors` (isolated). The admin saves a scratch list view gated on `manage_users`, plus a draft. A `setup.access`-only member does not see it in `GET /meta/view` and gets 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` on the plain read, `/published`, `/layers` and `?state=draft`. On `/history` that member gets 403 `FORBIDDEN` first, while a `studio.access` member gets the audience refusal `PERMISSION_DENIED`. The admin reads every door. When the member replays the admin's ETag, the answer is 403, never 304, beside the control that the admin's own replay is a 304 |
| security-catalog-activation-and-clone-doors | acceptance[2], [3] | `catalog-activation-door`: switching off `everyone` or `guest` is refused 400 naming the anchor, and no row is written. `permission-set-clone-door`: the source's own name is 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`. A closed body (a key missing, or an extra key) is 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` and nothing is saved. An anonymous caller is 401 |
| security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report | acceptance[1], [2], [4] | New `security-catalog-one-holder-http` (isolated). `POST /marketplace/install-local` with an inline manifest redeclaring `showcase_auditor` answers 422 `PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED`, naming the set and `com.example.showcase`, and `GET /packages` is unchanged. A permission-set save whose body `packageId` names another package answers 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` at `packageId`. The boot log, captured across two boots of one database file: the clean boot logs one INFO line; after 51 grants naming no catalog set are planted, the next boot logs one ERROR line with the grant ids capped at 50 (`more: 1`) |
| grant-table-write-contract | acceptance[1], [2], [3] | New `grant-table-write-contract` (isolated), over `POST /data/sys_user_permission_set`. `permission_set_id` gets 400 `INVALID_FIELD`. A duplicate grant gets 409 `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`. A grant naming someone else as `granted_by` stores the admin. `permission-set-assignment-window` gains the authored message, the absence of the `unevaluable` constraint, and the valid-window 201 control |

Ledger:

- The five items each get a rewritten `automated.ref` that maps clauses to cases, `revision` +1, and a `history` row citing #26571.
- As the seat's slice-3 order asks, activation-write-operator-gate, platform-owner-email-anchor and record-view-read-audit move from `automated.kind` `unit` to `dogfood`. Each gets `revision` +1 and a history row; their refs are unchanged.
- security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report moves to `dogfood` too, because its rewritten ref now leads with the dogfood pins. The order named only the three slice-2 items, so this one is a deviation, listed below.

Clauses left as they are, each with its reason in the item's `automated.ref`:

- Every item's acceptance[0] is the pin run itself (`test` oracle).
- security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report acceptance[3] is pinned in-process by the cli's integration test, which the `build` oracle accepts.
- grant-table-write-contract acceptance[4] is the walled-boot leg (knownGaps), scored from the engine pin.

## Tests

Head `abf45d31`, before the final no-overlap merge of main, ran the eight touched files under `os-verify-lock`: `Test Files 8 passed (8)`, `Tests 127 passed (127)` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0. The merge that followed brought in only `plugin-auth`'s set-manager change, other area ledgers and unrelated dogfood files. The full dogfood battery is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- anonymous-floor-v18-doors: `GET /api/v1/keys` answers the admin 405 `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, because the dispatcher registers every verb on `/keys` (#23909) and the domain serves POST alone. The admin control there is therefore omitted, and the anonymous 401 is the floor's by the same argument the item's knownGaps makes.
- meta-authoring-trail-and-audience-gates: the scratch view's column is `title`. A `name` column is refused at author time (`list-view-field-unknown`), because `showcase_task` has no `name` field.
- security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report: the scratch package id is `com.example.qa-one-holder`, because install-local refuses an underscore in a package id with 400 `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID` before registration.

## Verification

Local gate subset on head `6f533694` (origin/main merged): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 55 families. All 55 ran and exited 0, and `--ran` reconciles `55 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Repository-wide scans (`pnpm lint`, the full dogfood battery) are CI's.

`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned)`.

Changeset: none. `@objectstack/dogfood` is private and `docs/qa/**` ships in no package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
